# API Endpoint Scaffold Skill

When asked to create or update an API endpoint:
1. Define request/response types and input validation first.
2. Implement the route handler with structured error responses and status codes.
3. Generate unit tests covering 200 OK, 400 Bad Request, and error handling paths.
